name: sidestep-base
title: Sidestep the base
description: Move the base sideways by a signed distance (left positive) without turning, also while carrying a load; aligns the arm with a target that is a little to the side.
use_when: The robot must shift sideways a few centimetres without turning (align with a target).

not_to_be_confused_with.retreat: retreat moves straight back; sidestep moves sideways.
not_to_be_confused_with.face: face turns in place; sidestep keeps the heading.

postconditions.meaning: Base moved sideways by the signed distance (left > 0) within 3 cm, heading unchanged within 3 deg.

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
